version: LOCK 23 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - worship: Eid al-Adha and the sacrifice
builds_on: LOCK 9 meals for the poor, LOCK 13 Saeed the herder, LOCK 18 calendar, LOCK 19 fasting line and private record, LOCK 21 Eid prayer. Placeholders: {n}, {t}.

sheep.kicker: The Gate of Trust · Dhu al-Hijjah
sheep.title: Saeed the herder
sheep.text: Saeed has walked his flock in from the river fields. “A sheep for Eid? A year old, healthy, not a fault on it. Thirty coins.”
sheep.remembers: He looks at you twice. “You brought back my goats.” He picks you the best of the flock himself.
sheep.bought: Saeed ties a rope round its neck. It will wait in the inn's yard until Eid.

arafah_button: Intend to fast the Day of Arafah
arafah_toast: You eat before Fajr. Far away the pilgrims are standing at Arafah; here you fast.
arafah_line: Fasting the Day of Arafah · iftar at {t}
eid_line: Eid al-Adha · Eid Mubarak · no fasting today
tashreeq_line: Days of Tashreeq · days of eating, no fasting

eid.title: Eid al-Adha
eid.text: River Market prays in the open ground again. Idris speaks of Ibrahim and his son, and of giving up what you love for Allah. Then everyone goes to their animals.

sacrifice.title: The sacrifice
sacrifice.text: At the butcher's by the gate you hold the rope while he says “Bismillah, Allahu akbar.” It is quick, and the sheep does not see the knife before.
sacrifice.thirds: Share it in thirds: your table, your neighbours, the poor
sacrifice.all: Give it all to the poor
sacrifice.out_thirds: Salma takes a share for her lane, and Umm Salim's pot is full tonight.
sacrifice.out_all: Faris carries the meat from door to door until dark.
